query: Given this restaurant opening hours string: 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM, 7:30 PM - 10:30 PM, open on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays. Determine if the restaurant is OPEN on Sunday during typical lunch hours (around 12:00-15:00). Respond with open_on_sunday True if open during lunch on Sunday, else False.
